name: Coolify - Open Source PaaS
description: Coolify is a powerful, open-source, self-hostable alternative to PaaS solutions like Heroku, Netlify, and Vercel. It allows developers to seamlessly deploy applications, databases, and services to their own servers with a single click. In 2026, as cloud costs continue to rise, Coolify has become the cornerstone of modern self-hosting and DePIN edge compute deployments. By installing Coolify on a standard VPS (like Hetzner or DigitalOcean), users gain an elegant web dashboard to manage Git-push-to-deploy workflows, automatic SSL certificate generation via Let's Encrypt, zero-downtime deployments, and integrated database backups. Coolify supports deploying static sites, Node.js/Python apps, Docker images, and complex Docker Compose stacks. It effectively turns any bare-metal hardware into a fully managed, private cloud platform, drastically cutting infrastructure costs while maintaining developer velocity.
features: Git push-to-deploy for modern web frameworks
One-click deployment for popular open-source databases and tools
Automatic SSL provisioning and domain routing
Multi-server management from a single dashboard
